This is an example page. It's different from a blog post because it will stay in one place and will show up in your site navigation (in most themes).

Most people start with an About page that introduces them to potential site visitors. It might say something like this:

Hi there! I'm a bike messenger by day, aspiring actor by night, and this is my website. I live in Los Angeles, have a great dog named Jack, and I like piña coladas.

title: Hello World
content:
Welcome to RJ CMS! This is your first blog post. Edit or delete it, then start writing.

What is RJ CMS?

RJ CMS is a modern self-hosted CMS built on Laravel 12, featuring RJBuilder — a drag-and-drop visual page builder.

Getting Started

Visit the admin panel to create new posts, pages, menus, and more. You can switch any post or page to RJBuilder mode to design it visually.

Happy building!

title: Getting Started with RJBuilder
content:
RJBuilder is the visual page builder included with RJ CMS. It provides a modern drag-and-drop interface for designing pages, headers, footers, and popups.

Key Features

  • Drag-and-drop blocks
  • Responsive breakpoints (Desktop / Tablet / Mobile)
  • Custom CSS and animations
  • Dynamic tags for content
  • AI assistant integration

How to Use

Open any post or page in edit mode, select "RJBuilder" as the edit mode, and click "Open Builder". You can then start adding blocks and customizing styles.
